verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI design tool, but the evidence only shows interactive, prompt-driven work: generating designs, refining them through conversation, and one-off handoffs or exports. Nothing documents recurring schedules, triggers, or autonomous background runs. Automatically applying a design system to each project is a related behavior, not a user-configurable automation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
